title: Log answer
description: The answer of the command log, on standard output: the console text of the machine in the request's id. JSON escaping can make the answer larger than the text: a line feed is written as 2 bytes. So the adapter keeps the last part of the text such that the text is at most 768 KiB as UTF-8 and the answer, as written, is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. A member this schema does not define is refused.

log.description: The machine's console text, at most 768 KiB as UTF-8: the last part of the text when the whole text is larger. The text contains no U+0000. This schema checks the bound in characters, at most 786432.
